description:
Wall‑mount soap dispenser 350ml with sponge holder is the easiest way to declutter your kitchen sink or bathroom counter. Press once and get a clean, controlled dose of dishwash liquid or handwash—no messy puddles, thanks to the drip‑free silicone valve. The transparent reservoir shows the level instantly, so you refill before it runs out in the middle of cleaning.

The built‑in top caddy keeps your sponge or scrubber lifted, dry, and always within reach. Mount it on tile or glass using the adhesive bracket, or keep it freestanding if you prefer. Compact, neat, and fast to use with one hand, this soap dispenser helps your sink area look organized every day.

features: Built-in sponge holder (top caddy): Keeps sponge/scrubber off the counter for faster drying and a cleaner sink area.
Drip-free silicone valve: Seals after each press to reduce dripping, sticky residue, and messy soap trails.
One-hand easy-press pump: Dispenses a controlled amount quickly—ideal when your other hand holds dishes or a baby.
350ml transparent reservoir: See soap levels at a glance and refill before it runs out mid-clean.
Wall-mount or countertop use: Use the removable adhesive bracket for tile/glass mounting or place it freestanding on the counter.
Neat, space-saving design: Helps reduce clutter around the sink and keeps cleaning tools organized.
